technicalSummary: Strong structural foundation characterized by a near-ideal midface ratio and positive canthal tilt. Bone structure is well-defined and masculine, maintaining a balanced fWHR without blockiness.

personalizedInterpretation: The face is carried by elite eye area, near-ideal midface harmony, and a masculine frame. The score stops short of the 80s because the mouth/lip region is comparatively narrow and thin.
